args.description: a heavy overhead blow of the spiked greatsword into the ground. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
